On Tue, Feb 9, 2016 at 8:41 PM, Sunthud Pornprasertmanit <psun...@gmail.com> wrote:
Here is the code I used to test your model. It still works.


popmodel<-'A2~0.5*B1
 B2~0.3*A1+0.5*B1
 A1~~0.2*B1
 A2~~0.2*B2'

CLmodel<-'A2~B1
 B2~A1+B1
 A1~~B1
 A2~~B2'

dat <- simulateData(popmodel, sample.nobs = 200)
dat[matrix(as.logical(rbinom(200*4, 1, 0.1)), 200, 4)] <- NA

library(mice)
imp <- mice(dat, m=5)
mice.imp <- NULL
for(i in 1:5) mice.imp[[i]] <- complete(imp,action=i,include=FALSE)

library(semTools)
out <- runMI(CLmodel, data=mice.imp, chi="all",fun="sem")
